title: JavaScript Event Loop — Companion Resources
title_es: Event Loop de JavaScript — Recursos complementarios
description: Runnable Node.js demos of event loop internals: scheduling order of microtasks vs macrotasks, chunked long-task processing, and an event-loop lag monitor.
